title: feat(types)!: nine duration keys carry their unit in their name, old spellings refused by name (objectstack#25762)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao44byRSa5AQXv1uFcacVmaq)_

Part of objectstack#25762 (cutover prep E of the epic). Part of objectstack#25677.
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added

## Why

After objectui merges into objectstack as `ui/`, objectstack's spec gate `check:duration-unit-keys` walks `ui/packages/types/src/zod` too. It refuses a numeric key whose describe names a unit that the key name lacks. Nine keys here do that, so `timeout: 300` reads as either milliseconds or seconds. The maintainer chose to rename them (decision 17e = A, director thread 2026-10-25 09:06Z). Exempting `ui/` from the gate was the rejected option. The renames follow objectstack's own (objectstack#15679 / objectstack#15680): `…Ms` / `…Seconds`, the unit each describe already stated.

## The nine renames

| Node / schema | FROM | TO | Unit (from the describe) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `carousel` (`CarouselSchema`) | `autoPlay` | `autoPlayMs` | ms |
| `chatbot`, `chatbot-enhanced`, `chatbot-floating` | `autoResponseDelay` | `autoResponseDelayMs` | ms |
| `ActionSchema` | `timeout` | `timeoutMs` | ms |
| `ActionSchema.retry` | `delay` | `delayMs` | ms |
| `toast` (`ToastSchema`) | `duration` | `durationMs` | ms |
| `tooltip` (`TooltipSchema`) | `delayDuration` | `delayDurationMs` | ms |
| `hover-card` (`HoverCardSchema`) | `openDelay` | `openDelayMs` | ms |
| `hover-card` (`HoverCardSchema`) | `closeDelay` | `closeDelayMs` | ms |
| `report` (`ReportComponentSchema`) | `refreshInterval` | `refreshIntervalSeconds` | seconds |

Each name is the one the gate itself suggests in its finding line.

## Retirement mechanism

objectui has no conversion registry. A grep for `retiredKey`, `UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE`, `spec-changes` and `conversions` under `packages/types` and `scripts` finds only comments that cite the spec's helper. So, as the card allows, the conversion is the refusal plus the changeset table:

- **zod.** Each old key stays declared as a `retirementTombstone` (the objectui counterpart of the spec's `retiredKey`). The tombstone is fed by a new guidance builder, `durationKeyRenamedGuidance(retired, renamed, unit)` in `zod/tombstone.zod.ts`. An authored value is refused at the key's own path with code `invalid_type`, and the message names the new key: "RENAMED (objectstack#25762, ADR-0087) — `timeout` is now `timeoutMs` … the value (milliseconds) is unchanged." Without the tombstone, `.passthrough()` would keep the value unread. On the two chatbot twins, the tombstone is picked off `ChatbotSchema` the same way `maxToolRoundtrips` is.
- **TypeScript.** Each old member is `?: never` with `@deprecated`, so a typed literal fails to compile.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/25762-duration-keys-carry-unit.md` declares `minor` on `@object-ui/types`, `components`, `plugin-chatbot` and `plugin-report`, and carries the FROM → TO table.

## Readers that follow the rename

- `toast`, `tooltip` and `hover-card` renderers (`@object-ui/components`): the read, the registration `inputs` and `defaultProps`.
- The three chatbot registrations (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`): the read, `inputs` and `defaultProps`. The `useObjectChat` hook option keeps the name `autoResponseDelay`. It is a programmatic API, not a schema key (the same pattern as `body: schema.requestBody`).
- `ReportViewer` (`@object-ui/plugin-report`) reads `report.refreshIntervalSeconds`.
- Docs snippets (`toast`, `tooltip`, `hover-card`, `plugin-chatbot`, `report-schema`, `enhanced-actions`), three schema-catalog examples, and the tests that authored the old keys.
- New pin: `packages/types/src/__tests__/duration-unit-key-renames-25762.test.ts`. For each rename it checks that the new key accepts a number and refuses a string, and that the old key is refused at its own path naming the new key. It also has `@ts-expect-error` pins for every TypeScript twin.

## Verification

Head `a63bbdf3fd`: the card's two commits (`117dea6` rename, `7396eb3` docs) plus a merge of objectui `main` `be64bf6`. That merge brought in #13512 and #13513 at the dispatcher's request, with no conflict. The only shared file was `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`, in a different section. The local runs below were on base `0063f22ce` (pin `43edf90b56`). CI on this head covers the merged base and the new pin.

**Merged layout (the card's acceptance).** Verify head `9e37acd126`, plus `git diff 0063f22ce..117dea6` applied with `git apply --directory=ui` (the docs commit touches no `src/`), then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:duration-unit-keys`:

| | before (verify head alone) | after (+ this diff) |
|---|---|---|
| exit | 1 | 0 |
| `ui/` offenders | 9 (the nine keys above, `unit-in-prose-not-in-name`) | 0 |
| objectstack-side offenders | 0 | 0 |
| census | 210 unit-declaring keys / 4321 source files | 210 / 4321 |
| self-test | 114 cases, 13 batteries pass | same |

**objectui standalone.**

| Gate | Exit |
|---|---|
| `type-check`: `@object-ui/types` (src, examples, tests), `components`, `plugin-chatbot`, `plugin-report` | 0 each |
| vitest `packages/types/` | 389 of 390 files passed. `phase2-schemas` failed because it authored `timeout` / `retry.delay`; its fixture is renamed in this PR, and the file re-runs 35/35 |
| vitest `packages/components/` + `examples/schema-catalog/` | 479 files / 6677 tests passed (24 skipped, pre-existing) |
| vitest `packages/plugin-chatbot/` + `packages/plugin-report/` + the overlay / feedback / complex renderers | 142 files / 1272 tests passed |
| vitest `apps/console/` | 245 files / 2478 tests passed |
| `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-types`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:skill-examples` (after the scoped build each one asks for) | 0 each. `check:doc-json` first answered 1 on `schema-reference.md`'s `retry.delay`, which is fixed in `7396eb3` |
| `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:registry-bare-names` | 0 each |
| `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 each |
| changeset presence / no-major / fixed | 0 each |
| ESLint on the changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files | 0 errors (warnings are the files' existing `no-explicit-any`) |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the file list | NOT GOVERNED |

**Ablation.** With the five `zod/*.zod.ts` files reverted to `0063f22ce`, the new pin file reads 22 failed / 13 passed. Restored, it reads 35/35.

## Deviations from the order

1. **Changeset level `minor`, not `major`.** The card asks for a `major` changeset. objectui's AGENTS.md version policy forbids `major` in the fixed group (objectui's major follows `@objectstack`'s), and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses it in CI. So the bump is `minor`, and the body states the breaking semantics and the FROM → TO table.
2. **Refusal by named tombstone, not `.strict()`.** These mirrors are `.passthrough()` by design. A `.strict()` refusal would refuse every undeclared key on nine node types, which is wider than the card. objectui's own counterpart of the spec's `retiredKey` is `retirementTombstone`, and it refuses exactly the old key with a message that names the new one.
3. **`useObjectChat`'s `autoResponseDelay` option is not renamed.** It is the hook's programmatic API, not a schema key, and the gate does not judge it. The renderer maps `schema.autoResponseDelayMs` onto it.
4. **One extra docs commit.** `7396eb3` is the `schema-reference.md` JSON fence that `check:doc-json` refused.

**Residual, not widened (reported to the dispatcher).** `autoPlayMs` (carousel), `timeoutMs` and `retry.delayMs` / `retry.maxAttempts` (ActionSchema) have no renderer read, before or after this PR. They are declared but inert, and `enhanced-actions.mdx`'s "Retry Logic" section describes behaviour that nothing implements. The carousel registration spreads its props onto a `div`. An authored `autoPlay` used to land there as a valid `autoplay` attribute; an authored `autoPlayMs` now lands as an unknown one. Enforcing or removing these keys is a separate decision.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
